title: 船體總縱強度
summary: 將船體視為沿長度分佈的承載梁，從載重和浮力走到彎矩、截面與量測閉環。 在船體梁與應變資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Treat a hull as a distributed-load beam and connect weight/buoyancy to moments, section properties and measurements. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Hull-girder and strain-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 載重與浮力總量閉合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Closing total weight and buoyancy: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 載重與浮力總量閉合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Closing total weight and buoyancy and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船體總縱強度」的「載重與浮力總量閉合」中，靜水浮力等於排開水的重量；平衡時排水質量等於總質量。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：將船體視為沿長度分佈的承載梁，從載重和浮力走到彎矩、截面與量測閉環。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship hull-girder strength, Closing total weight and buoyancy examines this mechanism: Static buoyancy equals displaced-water weight; equilibrium displacement mass equals total mass. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Treat a hull as a distributed-load beam and connect weight/buoyancy to moments, section properties and measurements.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積 V=18 m³。關係式 M=ρV；含單位換算算式 1025*18 = 18450 kg。適用條件：只代表靜水質量平衡，未驗證傾覆、波浪與艙口進水。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Density 1025 kg/m³ and displaced volume 18 m³. Relation M=ρV; expression including unit conversion 1025*18 = 18450 kg. Applicability: Static mass balance only; capsize, waves and downflooding remain unverified.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同密度下仍假設相同載重和相同吃水，會讓質量與體積帳互相矛盾。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Assuming equal load and equal draft at different densities makes mass and volume accounting inconsistent. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「載重與浮力總量閉合」，分別以體積積分與質量清單重算，對照兩者差額。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Closing total weight and buoyancy, Recalculate from volume integration and a mass inventory, then compare their difference. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
